Apple (AAPL) Holder Gw Henssler & Associates LTD Has Cut Its Stake; Aegis Financial Has Increased Position in Fly Leasing LTD (FLY) 
April 21, 2018 - By Elijah Rosenthal 
Gw Henssler & Associates Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gw Henssler & Associates Ltd sold 3,144 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 208,413 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $35.27 million, down from 211,557 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gw Henssler & Associates Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $840.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26M shares traded or 56.69% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Aegis Financial Corp increased its stake in Fly Leasing Ltd (FLY) by 34.68% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aegis Financial Corp bought 139,404 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.62% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 541,400 shares of the company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.99 million, up from 401,996 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aegis Financial Corp who had been investing in Fly Leasing Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $366.02 million market cap company. The stock decreased 0.61% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $13.08. About 122,659 shares traded. Fly Leasing Limited (NYSE:FLY) has risen 1.84% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.71% the S&P500. 
Among 6 analysts covering FLY Leasing ( NYSE:FLY ), 3 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. The stock of Fly Leasing Limited (NYSE:FLY) earned “Sell” rating by Citigroup on Friday, December 8. Cowen & Co maintained Fly Leasing Limited (NYSE:FLY) on Monday, September 18 with “Buy” rating. Cowen & Co maintained the shares of FLY in report on Monday, July 10 with “Buy” rating. The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Outperform” on Wednesday, July 29. The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co on Monday, August 14 with “Buy”. The stock has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Thursday, September 21. JP Morgan maintained it with “Underweight” rating and $15 target in Tuesday, March 6 report. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Monday, September 21 by Bank of America. RBC Capital Markets maintained the shares of FLY in report on Friday, March 10 with “Outperform” rating. 
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. Apple Inc. had 399 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Tuesday, September 22, the company rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird. Macquarie Research maintained it with “Outperform” rating and $148 target in Friday, January 20 report. Piper Jaffray maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Thursday, November 30. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, August 2 by Nomura. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, April 27 by Macquarie Research. Robert W. Baird maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, October 4 report. Nomura maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Wednesday, September 6 with “Buy” rating. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.73 in Q4 2017. Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q3. Gw Henssler & Associates Ltd, which manages about $1.21 billion and $1.07B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr (QUAL) by 29,077 shares to 56,912 shares, valued at $4.72 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Exxon Mobil Corp (NYSE:XOM) by 10,625 shares in the quarter, for a total of 181,210 shares, and has risen its stake in Novo (NYSE:NVO). 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 5 insider sales for $26.72 million activity. Maestri Luca had sold 39,122 shares worth $6.83M on Thursday, April 12. SCHILLER PHILIP W also sold $11.56 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Tuesday, April 3. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 15.29 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
